title: Text plus number
starter:
count = 0
for i in range(3):
    step(1)
    grab()
    count += 1
say("I have " + count + " bananas")
hints: Read the message: + can't combine text and a whole number.
Use an f-string: f"I have {count} bananas", or str(count).

sk.title: Text plus číslo
hints: Prečítaj si správu: + nevie spojiť text a celé číslo.
Použi f-reťazec: f"I have {count} bananas" alebo str(count).
